title: No information on cancellation of subscription
body: Was searching information on how to cancel subscription and couldn’t find. Supporter Dave wrote - just delete the app. I wonder if I’ll be charged in a while. Suspicious and unsafe. Do not recommend
author: NoNicknameNeeded98

title: Great app!
body: Great app, customizable, nice design. Please review the possibility to start a habit at a particular time in the future coz now when you select the desired date it does not allow to save it and goes back to today’s date. Thanks!
author: VaiKaz

title: Lack of features
body:
There are a lot of shortcut options to put my habits on the home screen but all they do is open the main app. So it’s only informational. It would be awesome if I could check my habits as done from the home screen. Also, there should be an option for one shortcut to only use one square instead of 4. Now if I want to place 1 habit in home screen it takes 4 places where other apps could be.

Edit Habits’ widget on the home screen can be edited to enable tap to complete.
author: Klasas_

title: Beautiful app
body: Great app not only because of the visuals and great user interface, but its been motivating me to actually stick to my habits. The widgets are nice and stylish which means i can put them on my homescreen and have a constant reminder. The notifications arent annoying as well unlike some other habit tracking apps ive tried. Great app!
author: win776

title: Really well made
body: I think this app really is well made. Just full of many small details that are really helpful. Really recommend to anyone who wants to develop some habits and get better :))
author: saule1234

title: Best habits app
body: This app has everything you need, all habits that you could think of, reminders, weekly/monthly review!
author: Ag_naite

title: Best habbit app. Worth buying the pro
body: After trying what feels like dozens of habbit apps, Habbit is the only one that sticked. The design and UX are very straightforward while being super adaptable to your needs. I never rate apps or write reviews, but Habbit is too good not to share.
author: konccepcija

title: Very comfortable to use
body: Lately I’ve tried several habit tracking apps and this one is my favourite. It is very flexible, easy to use, the design is very minimalistic and I like that a lot. I can easily create very personal habits with specific parameters. Also I also like the reminders, which are not annoyingly spamming my phone, but appearing only on a certain time.
author: gileee.03

title: Highly recommend!
body: Great interface, easy to use and track all habits at the same time
author: laurynavicius

title: Amazing price and features. Love user sharing and sync with health
body:
The only negative is generic name which i think is hard to brand

A bit buggy sometimes with user sharing but still awesome, should also include cold shower exposure in lists and kegels, planks
author: DjiXas

title: Highly recommend
body: Highly recommend this app if you are looking to build new habits. It is easy to use, offers a range of pre-created options but also allows you to customise habits yourself, with colours, icons, motivational text and time for reminders. Love that it can be used as a widget on the screen!
author: Bea Jur

title: Incredibly powerful
body:
This app is very well thought through. It is very flexible and helps you to set up habits just the way you like it, I think it can be set up according to anyone's taste. 
Widgets are amazing, they are very very handy. Of course, any change has to come from within you. Apps are just a means to an end, but it is a very powerful app, highly recommend for anyone who is walking down this rocky path of. Habit building.
author: Deividas Kukis
